threshold_configuration_status.title: Threshold Configuration Status
threshold_configuration_status.description: Represents the operational state of alert threshold configuration and tuning: whether thresholds have been explicitly set, reviewed against baselines, and adjusted from defaults.

baseline_deviation_percentage.title: Baseline Deviation Trigger Percentage
baseline_deviation_percentage.description: The percentage deviation from baseline that triggers an alert. A value too high misses anomalies; a value too low causes excessive noise.

false_positive_rate_reviewed.title: False Positive Rate Reviewed
false_positive_rate_reviewed.description: Indicates whether the team has reviewed and documented the false positive rate of the current alert thresholds within the last review cycle.

suppression_rules_count.title: Active Alert Suppression Rules Count
suppression_rules_count.description: Count of active suppression, muting, or deduplication rules configured to reduce redundant or low-signal alert noise. High counts may indicate over-suppression masking real issues.

baseline_calculation_method.title: Baseline Calculation Method
baseline_calculation_method.description: The statistical method used to derive alert thresholds from historical operational data.

baseline_lookback_days.title: Baseline Lookback Period (Days)
baseline_lookback_days.description: The number of historical days used to compute the statistical baseline from which alert thresholds are derived.

threshold_auto_update_enabled.title: Automatic Threshold Update Enabled
threshold_auto_update_enabled.description: Indicates whether alert thresholds are automatically recalculated as new baseline data accumulates, preventing threshold drift over time.

severity_tiers_configured.title: Severity Tiers Configured
severity_tiers_configured.description: Indicates how many distinct severity tiers (warning, critical, emergency) are actively configured in the alerting system.

tier_thresholds_defined.title: Tier Thresholds Defined
tier_thresholds_defined.description: List of severity tier names that have explicit numeric threshold values assigned (e.g., ['warning', 'critical', 'emergency']).

escalation_paths_configured.title: Escalation Paths Configured
escalation_paths_configured.description: Whether differentiated escalation paths or notification channels are mapped to the defined severity tiers.

automated_response_enabled.title: Automated Response Enabled
automated_response_enabled.description: Whether automated remediation actions are enabled to trigger upon threshold breach events.

configured_response_actions.title: Configured Response Actions
configured_response_actions.description: List of automated remediation actions configured to execute on threshold breach (e.g., 'service_restart', 'traffic_block', 'ticket_creation', 'scale_out', 'isolate_host').

response_action_test_status.title: Response Action Test Status
response_action_test_status.description: Whether configured automated response actions have been validated through testing (e.g., fire drills, integration tests).

response_integration_endpoint_configured.title: Response Integration Endpoint Configured
response_integration_endpoint_configured.description: Whether a valid integration endpoint (webhook URL, API endpoint, queue ARN, etc.) is configured to receive and process automated response triggers.

audit_logging_enabled.title: Threshold Change Audit Logging Enabled
audit_logging_enabled.description: Indicates whether the system logs all changes to alert threshold configurations, capturing modification events for audit trail purposes.

change_record_completeness.title: Change Record Completeness
change_record_completeness.description: Indicates whether audit records for threshold changes include all required fields: actor identity (who), timestamp (when), previous value, new value, and reason/justification.

audit_log_retention_days.title: Audit Log Retention Period (Days)
audit_log_retention_days.description: Number of days threshold change audit logs are retained and queryable for compliance and forensic review.

unauthorized_change_alerting_enabled.title: Unauthorized Threshold Change Alerting Enabled
unauthorized_change_alerting_enabled.description: Indicates whether alerts or notifications are triggered when threshold configurations are modified by users outside of an approved change management process or by unexpected accounts.

composite_alerting_enabled.title: Composite Multi-Metric Alerting Enabled
composite_alerting_enabled.description: Whether the alerting system supports and has composite threshold rules configured that combine multiple metrics in a single alert condition.

composite_alert_rule_count.title: Number of Active Composite Alert Rules
composite_alert_rule_count.description: The total count of currently active alert rules that define thresholds spanning two or more metrics simultaneously.

metrics_covered_by_composite_rules.title: Metric Dimensions Covered by Composite Rules
metrics_covered_by_composite_rules.description: List of metric dimensions or categories (e.g., 'cpu', 'memory', 'error_rate', 'latency', 'disk_io') that are included in at least one composite alert rule.

time_window_defined.title: Time Window Defined
time_window_defined.description: Whether a specific time window or rate period is configured for the alert threshold evaluation.

window_duration_seconds.title: Window Duration (Seconds)
window_duration_seconds.description: The length of the evaluation time window in seconds over which the threshold is applied.

evaluation_type.title: Threshold Evaluation Type
evaluation_type.description: The method used to evaluate the threshold: whether it is rate-based (per time window), static, or rolling.

notification_channels_configured.title: Configured Notification Channels
notification_channels_configured.description: List of downstream channels configured to receive threshold-triggered alerts (e.g., SIEM, email, SMS, ticketing).

alert_routing_enabled.title: Alert Routing Enabled
alert_routing_enabled.description: Indicates whether automated routing of threshold-triggered alerts to configured channels is active.

channel_test_status.title: Channel Integration Test Status
channel_test_status.description: Result of the most recent end-to-end connectivity test for configured notification channels.

threshold_templates_defined.title: Threshold Templates Defined
threshold_templates_defined.description: Whether standardized alert threshold templates have been created and are available for reuse across systems.

template_coverage_scope.title: Template Coverage Scope
template_coverage_scope.description: The breadth of systems or service categories covered by the defined threshold templates.

template_adoption_percentage.title: Template Adoption Percentage
template_adoption_percentage.description: Percentage of monitored systems currently using templates rather than individually configured thresholds.
